title: Patek Philippe Neptune Power Reserve Moonphase Ref. 5085/1A-001
description: Maunder Watch Co have for sale a Patek Philippe Neptune Power Reserve Moonphase Ref. 5085/1A-001. Introduced in 1996 alongside the Aquanaut as part of Patek Philippe ’s renewed focus on stainless steel sports watches, the Neptune line established a more understated and unconventional identity within the brand’s catalogue. The Ref. 5085A followed in 1998 and remained in production until 2005. While it never achieved the same commercial recognition as the Aquanaut, the model represented an important shift in Patek Philippe’s design language and, in retrospect, foreshadowed many elements that would later appear in future sports references. Today, the 5085A maintains a loyal, cult-like following among collectors who appreciate its unusual design and niche position within the brand’s history. Its 37mm stainless steel case offers more presence than its slim, rounded profile initially suggests. The softly curved bezel gives the watch a refined appearance from the front, while the approximately 10mm case thickness is made possible by the ultra-thin in-house Calibre 240 architecture housed within. The result is a versatile sports watch that transitions comfortably between formal and casual wear, balancing elegance with practicality. The asymmetrical dial layout is one of the Ref. 5085A’s defining characteristics. It features a moonphase display with integrated date indication at 7 o’clock, a power reserve indicator positioned at 10:30, and running seconds at 4 o’clock. Although unconventional at first glance, the display quickly becomes intuitive in daily use. White Arabic numerals contrast sharply against the glossy black dial, accompanied by baton-style hands and an offset Patek Philippe signature positioned towards the upper right side of the dial. On this example, the luminous minute markers have aged to a warm yellow patina, adding further character. Completing the watch is its distinctive tapered stainless steel bracelet, constructed with a fish scale-like link design

title: Cartier Gondole ‘Jumbo Horizontale’ Ref. 97051
description: Maunder Watch Co have for sale a Cartier Gondole Jumbo Ref. 97051. In 1972, Cartier introduced the Louis Cartier Collection to coincide with the relocation of its manufacturing operations from France to Switzerland. The collection comprised twelve full-gold models, designed to reflect both Cartier’s historical designs and contemporary styling of the period. Among these, the Gondole Jumbo is regarded as the most distinctive reference. The Gondole Jumbo reflects the design language of the 1970s, with bold proportions and a strong architectural case. It was produced in two configurations—vertical and horizontal—this example being the horizontal version. The case measures 34.5 × 38 mm, making it notably large by Cartier standards of the era. A stepped bezel adds visual depth and increases the overall presence on the wrist. Despite its size, the dial remains classically executed. The white dial features black painted Roman numerals, a painted inner minute track, and a simple Cartier signature. The discreet “Paris” marking at 6 o’clock indicates an original dial supplied through Cartier’s Paris boutique at Place Vendôme , an important detail for collectors. The watch is fitted with blued steel sword hands and a sapphire cabochon crown. The case is manufactured in 18k yellow gold and is presented on a brown leather strap with an 18k yellow-gold Cartier buckle. Production of the Gondole Jumbo in yellow gold is believed to have been limited, with estimates suggesting approximately 50 to 70 examples were produced, contributing to the reference’s rarity and collectability.
